description: Name of the table the filter is being applied to
label: Table
name: tableName

description: Filter string to populate the condition builder
label: Encoded query
name: encodedQuery

description: Fixed query string to populate the condition builder
label: Fixed encoded query
name: fixedEncodedQuery

description: Mode for handling fixed queries. 'SIMPLE' or 'DISTRIBUTED'
label: Fixed query mode
name: fixedQueryMode

description: Show dot walk to allow users to filter on reference or extended tables. If this is set to false, only the first panel will show.
label: Show dot walk
name: enableDotwalking

description: An optional array of fields that appear when using the condition builder
label: Field inclusion list
name: fieldInclusionList

description: An optional array of fields that will not be included when using the condition builder
label: Field exclusion list
name: fieldExclusionList

description: This is an advanced property that should rarely be configured. When set to true and other system properties are met, this will make is so that any operator exclusion that is defined on the table and/or field level is respected.
label: Include excluded operators
name: includeExcludedOperators

description: Boolean flag to include extended operators set through dictionary attributes
label: Include extended operators
name: includeExtendedOperators

description: This is an advanced property that should rarely be configured as its for supporting a legacy format for variables most commonly found in a ui16 form. If true, the variablesHASITEMVARIABLE:sys_id syntax will be used for all variables terms as opposed to the default variables.sys_id syntax.
label: Use has item variable syntax
name: useHasItemVariableSyntax
